provenance.notes: MyDHL API (rates, shipments, tracking): no production limit published; 500 calls a day in its test environment only. Terms of use: no indexing, caching or storing of content beyond what is technically necessary and temporary, no bypassing call limits. MyDHL: an active DHL Express account, used only for one's own DHL Express shipments; rating data neither stored, modified nor shown to third parties. Location data neither stored nor modified; next to other carriers' points, every DHL location at that address shown. MyDHL's Message-Reference header is echoed back but deduplicates nothing: a shipment is sent once.
